name: dvma-appium-automation
description: Appium + WebdriverIO dynamic-analysis automation suites for DVMA (Damn Vulnerable Mobile App). Exercises every instrumented module to surface its vulnerability. Authorized security-training use only.

scripts.smoke:ci: node --check wdio.android.conf.js && node --check wdio.ios.conf.js && node --check wdio.shared.conf.js && node --input-type=module -e "for (const c of ['./wdio.android.conf.js','./wdio.ios.conf.js']) { const m = await import(c); if (!m.config || !Array.isArray(m.config.specs)) process.exit(1); }"

comment_appium_drivers: Appium itself and its drivers are installed separately (globally or via appium's own plugin manager), NOT as npm project deps. See automation/README.md. Required: appium (>=2), appium-uiautomator2-driver, appium-xcuitest-driver, appium-flutter-driver.
comment_overrides: Force patched versions of transitive deps that Appium/wdio still pull in vulnerable. These packages are dev-only test tooling and never ship in the app, but pinning the fixed versions keeps the dependency audit clean. extract-zip has no fixed release (every version incl. 2.0.1 is flagged for symlink traversal), so instead of overriding it directly we pin its only parent @puppeteer/browsers to 3.x, which dropped the extract-zip dependency entirely; @wdio/utils requests ^2.2.0 but works with 3.x since it only uses the browser-download path we never exercise.
